subject: log-fields
text: - A closed span's line — a second record class since 2026-10-07-driver-command-spans, a boundary widening ratified by the founder (2026-10-09) as built — is written for each closed span whose target the allowlist admits, and no line when a span is created, recorded to, entered or exited: `{time} {LEVEL} {target} service.name=… service.version=… span={the span's name}`, then the span's own fields in the order recorded, then the layer's close fields `message`, `time.busy` and `time.idle`; level and target are the span's, the two timings are `tracing-subscriber`'s own (no escher code reads a clock for them), and `span` is a reserved field name; every pair, `span` included, passes the §8 scrub under the span's target; a string value is Debug-quoted (`span="command"`, `message="close"`), a number or a bool bare; a span from a target outside the allowlist writes no byte at any point; an event's line is unchanged, an event emitted inside a span included — it gains no span name and no span field; as read from a real capture: `… INFO escher_driver service.name=blitz-tests service.version=0.3.0-beta.2 span="command" verb="click" passes=1 settled=true added=1 removed=0 changed=1 message="close" time.busy=11.0ms time.idle=4.51µs` (packages/escher-telemetry/src/lib.rs:102-116; packages/escher-telemetry/src/format.rs:138-177; packages/escher-telemetry/src/format.rs:200-250; as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-07-driver-command-spans/report.md)

subject: log-fields
text: - The verdict fields: `task, client_exit, isolated, session_tools, client_version, model, tool_calls, server_tool_calls, wrong_calls, refused_calls, error_calls, spacer_calls, transcript_errors, counts_agree, tasks_met, check_steps, check_expects, check_passed, check_can_fail, num_turns, duration_ms, cost_usd, input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_input_tokens, cache_creation_input_tokens, transcript_file, outcome, reasons, ts` (`final_count` retired at 2026-10-15-cold-agent-test) — every one a count, a boolean or a closed word, no transcript text, tool argument, tool answer, reply or check; `counts_agree` ties the server's span lines to the transcript (the `tool_call` lines equal the escher tool uses, its refused + error lines the escher results marked `is_error`), `wrong_calls` = refused + error + foreign tool uses + permission denials, and the reasons add `no-check`, `check-failed`, `check-cannot-fail` (scripts/cold-agent.sh:308-393; scripts/cold-agent.sh:148-157)

 a recording directory open to its group or others ends `start` with status 3 and nothing spawned and `mcp --record` with status 3, its fixed message on stderr and stdout empty, the two recording session errors ending status 3 like the rest; the two-argument form `<task> <state-dir>` is gone (it reads as an unknown verb, refused, status 1), every diagnostic is a fixed string holding no path, label, id or value, and no ending holds anything the caller typed (examples/seven_guis/src/session_host.rs:21; packages/escher-driver/src/cli.rs:278-293; packages/escher-driver/src/cli.rs:341-368; packages/escher-driver/src/cli.rs:370-383)

subject: emitter-escher-driver
text:
- **escher-driver (in a process that installs escher's sink at `info` or below)**
  - one closed-span line per call to `Session::run`: INFO at target `escher_driver`, `span="command"`, with the recorded ones of `verb`, `cause`, `settled`, `busy`, `passes`, `added`, `removed`, `changed`, then `message="close"`, `time.busy`, `time.idle` — the verb table's twelve words (eight instance-level; the three session-level ones and the tool-level `help` only beside the cause `unknown-verb`), eight cause names (ratified by the founder, 2026-10-18), three busy-class words, bools and counts; since 2026-10-12-headless-screenshot a shot's line is `span="command" verb="screenshot"` (with `cause` when refused) and holds no image byte, size or dimension — measured: 0 occurrences of the first 64 base64 characters of a shot in the `escher-session` host's and the `mcp` role's stderr at `trace`, under both builds (`host_log`, `mcp_log`; examples/seven_guis/tests/host_log.rs:155-168; examples/seven_guis/tests/mcp_log.rs:141-154); a lint's line is `span="command" verb="lint"` (with `cause` when refused) and holds no finding, id, bound or count — `host_log` and `mcp_log` each drive one `lint` at `trace` with 0 needles; a part read's line is `span="command" verb="snapshot"` (with `cause` when refused, a `part` outside 1 to 1000 refused `malformed`) and holds no part number, count, size or text — `host_log` and `mcp_log` each drive one part read at `trace` with 0 needles; no line at the default `warn`; the emitters are the two re-run children of `stand_act_spans`, in process, and since 2026-10-10-driver-cli the `escher-session` host — its wire (`v3`) carries `hello`, `stop` and `call` — a call after which the host's recording ended answered by the one fixed reply `recording-failed` —, and its host role writes one closed-span line per call at `info` or below (measured at `trace`: 3 lines for 3 calls);
 since 2026-10-10-mcp-surface also the `escher-session mcp` role and `serve_mcp` in process (`stand_mcp_tools`); `seven_guis_native` runs none (packages/escher-driver/src/execute.rs:96-111; packages/escher-driver/src/execute.rs:302-341; as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-07-driver-command-spans/report.md, the host's lines at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-10-driver-cli/report.md)
  - since 2026-10-10-mcp-surface, one closed-span line per MCP tool call: INFO at target `escher_driver`, `span="tool_call"`, with the recorded ones of `tool` (the table's word, one of its twelve, `help` among them since 2026-10-12-self-description and `screenshot` since 2026-10-12-headless-screenshot, and `lint`) and `ending` (`accepted` · `refused` · `error`), then `message="close"`, `time.busy`, `time.idle` — e.g. `span="tool_call" tool="start" ending="accepted" message="close"`; a `help` call's line reads `span="tool_call" tool="help" ending="accepted"` with no `command` line beside it; no line at the default `warn`; the emitters are the `escher-session mcp` role and `serve_mcp` in process; over one CRUD flow at `info` the role's stderr reads 9 lines built alone and 10 built with the workspace — the tenth `INFO blitz_dom::document … message=[redacted]` — with 5 `tool_call` and 3 `command` lines in each (packages/escher-driver/src/mcp.rs:118-121; as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-10-mcp-surface/report.md, read on the hand-run role, 2026-10-11); re-measured at 2026-10-14-stand-requirement-sweep, 9 built alone and 11 built with the workspace — the `blitz_dom::document` INFO line now printing twice — the 5 `tool_call` and 3 `command` lines unchanged, needles 0 (as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-14-stand-requirement-sweep/evidence/log-counts.md)
